Package com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.eye.behavior

Class BehaviorInstance

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.eye.behavior.BehaviorInstance
public final class BehaviorInstance extends Object
The mutable runtime state of the one behavior a mob is currently playing. Behaviors themselves are stateless singletons (EyeBehaviors); all per-play state lives here, on the mob's client tracker, so it's transient and per-mob.

The only animated state is age: each behavior derives its EyeInfluence directly from age/duration in EyeBehavior.influence(com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.eye.behavior.BehaviorInstance, int, int, com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.eye.behavior.EyeInfluence), so there are no prev/current scalar pairs to keep — the smoothing lives one level down, in the pupil's own physics interpolation and in the per-eye overlay state the simulator tracks. The seeded params below are resolved once in EyeBehavior.onStart(com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.eye.behavior.BehaviorInstance); randomness is seeded so every client watching the same mob animates identically.
